$comment: Single source of truth for every color the theme may use. Generators map into it; ThemeLintTest rejects anything outside it. Base: sainnhe/gruvbox-material, dark, background=soft, foreground=material. Blue is remapped to tan everywhere except the keys listed in restricted.

restricted.$comment: blue (#7daea3) is allowed only here: ANSI blue keeps terminal output legible, and blue icons keep class/interface glyphs distinct. Patterns are regexes on the scheme attribute/color key, or on the theme.json path.

rules.$comment: No color anywhere may be brighter (relative luminance) than fg0: bright glyphs and blocks are what bloom. No bold or italic in the editor scheme.
